races.paceDynamic: Independent Expert looks the lone confirmed pace-setter with most others holding prominent or hold-up positions, creating a race where the early leader may get an uncontested lead. The lack of natural pace pressure means Independent Expert can dictate terms through steady fractions before quickening. With limited early speed in the field beyond the leader, this sets up perfectly for front-runners and prominent racers who can track the pace and strike. Hold-up horses like Clonmacash and Salacious face the tactical disadvantage of giving Independent Expert too much rope and needing to make up significant ground in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Independent Expert gets soft early fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: The eight-time winner can control the race from the front and has enough in reserve to hold off late challengers over this trip he's won at before. His recent Naas success over 7f on soft ground gives him the perfect template here.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Independent Expert sets reasonable pace but fades in final furlong
scenarios.body: The lack of pace allows prominent runners to sit handy and time their challenge perfectly as the leader weakens. Venetian from the same yard knows how to position himself just off the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The slow early pace sets up a bunch finish where hold-up horses can unleash their turn of foot. Clonmacash's recent Dundalk win shows he has acceleration when produced late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is messy with multiple horses disputing the early lead
scenarios.body: A muddling race where the expected pace scenario breaks down completely allows a fresh horse to capitalize. West Sedona as the unknown quantity could benefit from any tactical confusion.

races.paceDynamic: Rampage is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 18-runner handicap and should get an uncontested lead with the next most forward being Not Simple and Master Garvey who are prominent runners rather than pure pace-setters. The lack of early pace pressure means Rampage can dictate terms and kick for home when ready, while the vast majority of the field are hold-up horses who will need the race to develop into a sprint finish. With 15+ runners sitting back and relying on a late charge, the tactical advantage lies heavily with those who can secure good early positions. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the back-markers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Rampage gets an easy lead and maintains stamina to the line
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows him to control the race and kick clear when the field is still organising behind him. His prominent style perfectly suits the tactical setup with so many hold-up horses needing luck in running.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes unsustainably slow and the field bunches up for a cavalry charge
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their preferred scenario with a genuine sprint finish where the best handicapped can show their turn of foot. Traffic problems will still eliminate many but the classier operators can weave through.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Rampage sets steady fractions but weakens in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The horses tracking the leader in prominent positions can pounce when the front-runner falters while avoiding the chaos further back. Not Simple or Master Garvey can capitalise on their tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Emerges Late
scenarios.trigger: If traffic clears perfectly for a well-handicapped hold-up horse hitting the line
scenarios.body: One of the back-markers gets a dream run through and benefits from the soft early pace to unleash a devastating late rally. This requires significant luck but the pace setup makes it possible.

races.paceDynamic: Sparan Nua will dictate from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters in this small field. Lady Mairen may track prominently in second, while hold-up horses Vauntingly and Marmeladova will settle towards the rear. The uncontested lead creates a searching gallop that will test stamina over this extended 1m1½f trip. This tactical setup strongly favors front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early, as the hold-up horses face a difficult task from so far back in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sparan Nua Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Sparan Nua gets an easy lead and dictates moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The winner can control the tempo and kick clear when ready, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back in a small field with limited pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Lady Mairen Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Mairen tracks the leader closely and times her challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The experienced mare uses her class advantage to collar Sparan Nua in the final furlong, benefiting from prominent positioning and superior Group-race experience.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Marmeladova Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely testing and sets up for a closer
scenarios.body: The recent winner gets the strong gallop needed for her hold-up style and her fitness edge tells in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Vauntingly Improves Dramatically
scenarios.trigger: If the inexperienced filly shows major improvement from her debut run
scenarios.body: The J.P. O'Brien runner overcomes her slow-break tendencies and benefits from the race experience gained at this track.

watchPoints.text: Sparan Nua getting too easy a lead early - if uncontested through half-mile she becomes very hard to peg back
Lady Mairen's fitness after 17-day break - any signs of needing the run would be concerning given her class advantage
Vauntingly breaking cleanly from stalls - slow start killed her chances last time and small field offers little cover
Marmeladova carrying 142lbs top weight over this extended trip - any laboring under burden in closing stages
Going conditions staying consistent - any further softening would particularly suit Lady Mairen's proven form on easier ground

races.paceDynamic: Parish Express is the only confirmed front runner in this 17-runner field, likely to get an uncontested lead with Whats New and Makaiah settling prominently behind. The lack of early pace pressure means Parish Express can dictate terms through moderate fractions, potentially softening up the race for closers. With 14 hold-up horses in the field, there will be significant traffic problems in the straight as runners fan wide looking for racing room. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can avoid the crush and hold-up horses with proven tactical speed to weave through gaps.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Parish Express gets easy fractions and stays the trip
scenarios.body: The mare can control the pace without pressure and kick clear when the field gets bottled up behind. Declan McDonogh's tactical nous overcomes her recent steering issues.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and prominent runners get first run
scenarios.body: Makaiah or Whats New can sit handy, avoid traffic, and strike when Parish Express weakens. Their recent form edge tells in a slowly-run contest.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If genuine pace develops and gaps appear late
scenarios.body: The step up to 1m6f suits several hold-up horses who need the trip. Master Sydney or Celtic Druid can produce their best with a true gallop to aim at.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a cavalry charge with chaos
scenarios.body: Eastern Blue Bird or Sonic Invader emerge from the pack when others get hampered. Colin Keane's booking of Sonic Invader looks significant after his seasonal return.

Mr Rango running just two days after Roscommon - stamina reserves may be compromised over this longer trip
Colin Keane taking over on Sonic Invader suggests stable confidence after his disappointing seasonal return
Celtic Druid and Good Onya Mate both carry 7lb claiming allowances which could prove decisive in tight finish

races.paceDynamic: Velvet And Vine appears the only confirmed front runner in this field of 15, meaning she can dictate a comfortable early pace without pressure. The majority of runners are hold-up types including Desert Friend, Mephisto, Jurality and God The Highness, creating a bunched field tracking the leader through the middle stages. Over 2 miles on good to yielding ground, this sustainable pace scenario will allow the front runner to maintain energy reserves for the finish while creating tactical complications for the large pack behind. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and early position takers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will emerge from the packed field behind the lone leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Velvet And Vine maintains a steady tempo without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The large field of hold-up horses will struggle to coordinate their challenges, allowing the leader to kick clear in the straight. Traffic problems behind will prevent several runners from getting clear runs at crucial moments.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the field remains tightly bunched turning in
scenarios.body: Superior finishing kicks will decide the outcome as multiple horses launch simultaneous challenges. The strongest stayers with tactical speed will prevail in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Tempo Change
scenarios.trigger: If prominent runners like Desert Friend or Jurality move forward to pressure Velvet And Vine
scenarios.body: The increased gallop will stretch the field and favour horses with early pace who can position handy. Those held up too far back will find the gap opening too quickly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Velvet And Vine goes too slowly and gets swamped by the field early
scenarios.body: A messy, stop-start affair develops with no clear pace angle, favouring the classiest horse who can quicken when openings appear. Pure ability trumps tactical positioning.

watchPoints.text: Velvet And Vine after 491 days off - if she shows early pace rust or gets headed early, the race dynamic completely changes
Traffic problems at 2f out - with 12+ hold-up horses bunched behind the leader, multiple runners will get blocked
Desert Friend and claimer Conor Cusack - just won together at Sligo and drop back from 1m6f specialists
Late scratches from reserves - Bynx, Ethereal Star, and Sioux Grit could alter the pace dynamic if withdrawn
Going deterioration - multiple reports show Good To Yielding throughout the card, favouring hold-up types if it softens further
